items.html: And this is the reason that we see by natural sense that while the fetus is in its mother's womb it is like a still stone, without Daat, and when it emerges, a bit of the revelation of Daat begins in it, for what it needs. It cries when it wants to nurse, so that they will take pity on it, and it screams and signals hints. And the more it grows through the nursing, so its Daat also grows from degree to degree — but not a complete Daat, as in Gadlut, because they are still Names of Elokim, and there is still no Havayah in them, as stated. And the reason of the matter is that the essence of the Mochin of Daat is for the purpose of coupling in order to procreate, for upon it depends the procreation. And when he is thirteen years old, then he is fit to procreate, and the Mochin of Daat is completed in him, as I have written above.
